question: the ACC_5V boost's switch node is measured routable at zero vias -- what actually stands between that and copper, and is the rest of the board's 16 edges a LAYER problem or a CORRIDOR problem?

findings.title: THE B GND PLANE CAN REACH U21.4, AND THE OBSTACLE IS THE BOARD'S OWN SYS POUR -- NOT GEOMETRY
findings.detail: D-702 priced U21.4's ground on the reading that the B GND fill cannot bridge a 0.109 mm gap beside U21.5's land. The real obstacle is the zone `B /01_POWER_TREE/BQ25185_SYS POUR 2`, outline (55,33)-(60,42) mm, whose east lobe occupies the whole pocket east of U21. Pulling its east edge 60.000 -> 58.400 mm leaves L4.1 <-> U21.3 joined through the pour's own west lobe, floods B GND across the U21 east pocket AND onto U21.4's land, and lets the 6.3 mm GND chain (58.700,39.375)->(60.600,38.425) x2 be removed with GND STILL CLOSED.

findings.title: THE C65 MOVE IS 0.350 mm EAST, NOT 1.3 mm, AND IT IS ARITHMETIC
findings.detail: U21.4's land ends at x 58.8505 and C65.1's land began at x 59.585 -- a 0.7345 mm gap. A 0.600 mm SWITCH_NODE trunk owes 0.200 mm pad clearance on each side, so it needs 0.900 mm. C65 +0.350 mm east takes the gap to 1.0845 mm. apply_part_shift PASS: no new courtyard overlap, NO stranded endpoint (the 0805's 1.45 mm-tall lands keep both track ends on the pad), and the GND stitch barrels that sit under C65.2 sat under it ALREADY -- the authority carries four of them plus an ACC_5V_RAW barrel under C65.1, so via-in-pad at C65 is pre-existing and is not introduced by this move.

findings.title: ACC_5V_LX AND ACC_5V_RAW BOTH ROUTE, ZERO VIAS, AND failed_nets IS EMPTY
findings.detail: On that base, with the GND chain gone, /01_POWER_TREE/ACC_5V_LX routes U21.5 -> L4.2 in 3.209 mm, ZERO vias, all B.Cu, through a 0.475 mm neck at 0.200 mm inside U21's courtyard (0.225 mm of it outside, licensed by --neck-reach-mm), and /01_POWER_TREE/ACC_5V_RAW re-lays U21.6 -> C65.1 in 2.690 mm, ZERO vias. 3.209 mm against D-702's 4.533 mm.

findings.title: THE REFUSAL IS GND, AND IT IS A 3.05 mm2 PENINSULA WITH NO LEGAL BARREL AT ANY DIAMETER
findings.detail: The LX trunk crosses the only place the B GND plane joins U21.4: the flare at y 38.4..39.4. What it severs is a 3.05 mm2 peninsula -- U21.4's land, the 0.6 mm GND column between L4's two 3.7 mm pads, and the blob north of L4 -- and NO through barrel fits inside it. Measured with the gate's own via lattice at 0.025 mm over x 58.25..59.45, y 34.4..39.3: 0 legal cells at 0.60/0.30, 0 at 0.50/0.25 and 0 at 0.35/0.20 -- the fine-pitch geometry this file already licenses. Per layer, F.Cu and In2.Cu block every cell. The In2 blocker is /09_COMMUNITY_HEADER/EXT_SDA_BUF (58.700,34.000)->(60.300,40.800), the Qwiic I2C haul routed DIAGONALLY THROUGH the accessory boost's ground; the F.Cu blocker is the /09_COMMUNITY_HEADER/ACC_DETECT_N_HDR elbow (58.975,37.425)->(59.682,38.119). The nearest legal GND barrel site to U21.4 is 3.707 mm away at (61.25,41.90), on the far side of C65.

findings.title: AND TIGHTENING THE SYS POUR IN Y DOES NOT RECONNECT IT
findings.detail: SYS POUR 2 reshaped a second time to (55,34.1)-(58.4,39.8) -- so B GND gains the full width above and below it -- measured ON the routed candidate: GND still carries exactly one open edge and it is still U21.4. The peninsula does not wrap.

findings.title: U11.9 AND U11.3 LAUNCH -- FIVE DECISIONS OF NO_LEGAL_ESCAPE END HERE
findings.detail: With --trunk-floor reading D-690's OWN per-net 0.150 mm floor for /BQ25185_STAT1 and /BQ25185_STAT2, --escape-floor, the off-centre launcher and a 0.50/0.25 maze barrel, U11.9 reports 3 source escapes and U11.3 reports 1. Both nets are now purely NO_PATH -- 'no all-layer corridor at 0.150 mm between the islands'. The land is no longer the wall.

findings.title: OPENING In3.Cu TO THOSE TWO NETS IS MEASURED VACUOUS
findings.detail: This board routes on THREE layers -- F, In2, B -- because In1 (GND), In3 (+3V3) and In4 (GND) carry filled pours and route_maze_batch reserves an inner plane to the net that owns it. A new env-gated licence AQROOT_PLANE_SIGNAL='I3:/NET,...' (default UNSET and a byte-for-byte no-op) put the question for the first time. With layers F/B/In2/In3 the STAT pair's answer is IDENTICAL, gap for gap: NO_PATH at 0.150 mm on all three pairs. The third routing layer is not what the STAT pair lacks.

findings.title: AND NEITHER IS THE SYS POUR JOINABLE AT ANY WIDTH THE BOARD PUBLISHES
findings.detail: screen_island_join.py over /01_POWER_TREE/BQ25185_SYS at BOTH rungs -- the netclass contract (0.800 mm, 0.80/0.40) and the .kicad_dru / board floor (0.500 mm, 0.65/0.40) -- reports joined 0 / 7. L4.1+U21.3, U12.10+U12.11, C26.2 and C27.1 are NO_PATH; R68.1, U11.1 and U13.3 are NO_ANCHOR. D-689's jumper was the only one this board had.

findings.title: THE U11.9 CORRIDOR EXISTS AND ITS MINIMAL CUT NAMES /01_POWER_TREE/ISET
findings.detail: screen_pair_corridor_blame.py --per-object on U11.9 <-> TP6.1 at the 0.150 mm width the trunk now routes at. Q1: with the twelve foreign nets' routed copper removed inside a 3 mm window the pair routes in 18.756 mm on B.Cu with ZERO vias -- the corridor is OCCUPIED, not absent. Q2: NO single net opens it. Q3 reverse-greedy drops /01_POWER_TREE/BAT_PROTECTED_P, /01_POWER_TREE/BQ25185_SYS and /01_POWER_TREE/ILIM_VSET and names /01_POWER_TREE/ISET REQUIRED. ISET is a 5.7 mm pair (R37.1 <-> U11.8) routed as 15.53 mm hugging the east board edge, and it is NOT protected copper.

findings.title: EVICTING /01_POWER_TREE/USB_VBUS_CHG WHOLE IS REFUSED, AND MEASURED
findings.detail: 65 objects removed; the rebuild reports TOO_LONG at 68.833 / 71.384 / 72.816 mm against the 40 mm per-join bound and NO_PATH at 0.500 mm on U11.10+C23.2 <-> R35.2. 16 -> 19, nets_regressed [/01_POWER_TREE/USB_VBUS_CHG]. The U-turn south of U11 is not removable as a whole net.

findings.title: EVERY REMAINING SINGLETON LAND LAUNCHES; EVERY ONE IS A CORRIDOR
findings.detail: screen_offcentre_launch at the class-floor rungs: U9.10 opens at 0.250 mm, U9.14 at 0.200 mm (= its contract), U16.3 at 0.250 mm (above its 0.200 contract), U2.20 at 0.500 mm, U3.20 at 0.500 mm -- every one of them centre-anchored REFUSED. Only U5.2 (+3V3) and U21.5 (on the unmodified authority) are SEALED at every rung. A whole-board run of /04_SPI_B_RADIOS_NFC/NFC_VDD_RF, /I2C_SCL_INT, /ACC_PWR_EN and /SX1262_DIO1 under the off-centre launcher reports src_escapes 34 / 10 / 3 and dst_escapes 2 / 5 / 8 and NO_PATH on every one.
